assertions.subject: Substance/medication-induced psychotic disorder

assertions.subject: Psychotic disorder due to another medical condition
assertions.quote: A substance/medication—induced psychotic disorder due to a prescribed treatment for a mental or medical condition must have its onset while the individual is receiving the medication

assertions.subject: Psychotic disorder due to another medical condition
